answer_1.quote: We conducted extensive experiments on four QA datasets and three LLMs, demonstrating that PA-RAG significantly enhances the generator's performance.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to questions with citations, evaluated for correctness and citation quality.

answer_2.quote: For correctness, we assess whether the short answers ... are exact substrings of the generation to calculate the exact match (EM) score. For citation quality, we use citation recall ... and citation precision ... We follow ALCE, using MAUVE to evaluate the fluency of the model's responses.

answer_3.quote: We follow AlpacaEval and use the LLM (GPT-3.5-Turbo) evaluation to qualitatively judge PA-RAG vs IFT.
